tasks.title: The result of avg(distinct xx）is different between from primary and secondary

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 已有可操作场景、输入与可观察对照；纳入探索队列不等于确认目标版本受影响。

test_spec.setup: 按正文创建带utf8_bin字符串b/c与二级索引的t1，插入列出的10行。
test_spec.steps: 对同一静态表分别使用PRIMARY与idx_b_l等索引执行AVG(DISTINCT b)、SUM(DISTINCT b)，同时输出去重后的b及数值转换。
test_spec.oracle: 索引选择不能改变DISTINCT聚合语义；核对3.5/3.7、14/37差异，警告单独保存。
requirements: 保存完整SQL、配置、输出与错误日志
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标8.0支持所述SQL/功能；是否仍存在该异常须在各目标版本实测。

explicit_requirements: 保存完整SQL、配置、输出与错误日志

comments.text:
Please do not submit the same bug more than once. An existing bug report already describes this very problem. Even if you feel that your issue is somewhat different, the resolution is likely
to be the same. Because of this, we hope you add your comments to the original bug instead.

Thank you for your interest in MySQL.

You have already filed the same bug here:

https://bugs.mysql.com/bug.php?id=113060

Duplicate.
